derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a comparative of G4314 (πρός) and (to go);

occurrences.text: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
